brief:
Palestinian information center Matat documented approximately 1,734 violations by Israeli occupation forces and settlers in the West Bank between August 28 and September 3, 2026, according to Shehab Wire. The tally covers a seven-day period spanning the end of summer and early September.

The violations included incidents involving both military operations and settler actions across the occupied territory. Matat, which tracks such incidents systematically, has been recording Palestinian accounts of confrontations, property damage, arrests, and other alleged breaches during the monitoring period. The center maintains detailed records of incidents reported by residents and witnesses in communities throughout the West Bank.
